reviews.text: Like clicks?. There is an odd clicking sound about every 5 minutes on the white noise band. It’s not loud enough to wake me up, but it does disturb me as I am trying to fall asleep. So I cannot use this for sleeping.
reviews.theme: артефакты и сбои в петле звука

reviews.text:
Using Sounds for sleep. Twice in the middle of the night…LOUD ADS BLASTED OUT OF THE SPEAKER! 
It disturbed my important night of sleep after I had been diagnosed with a brain tumor. I’ll NEVER use this again!

Noises of games. What kind of a sleep app wakes you hours later with AWFUL game ads and a stupid-sounding voice talking?! 

It's darned near frightening! I about had a panic attack.
Pink sound is amazing. I love it! I have ADHD !!! Sleeping is difficult, not any longer.

Woken up by ads. First night was awesome. Slept through the night first time in over a year. Second night was awakes by people talking. I thought another app had opened by mistake. What a horrible app that plays ads while you are trying to sleep.

The ads ruin it. The app is easy to use but randomly plays ads and podcasts in the background. I was trying to find something for my newborn and every time he would finally fall asleep some random ad would come on and wake him up.

Great app except getting woken by ads. Love the brown noise for sleep while on vacation. The first night or two of sleep was ad-free and then last night got woken by 2 ads. I can’t imagine how trying to advertise to people who are trying to sleep is effective. Deal breaker. Please offer a paid, ad-free version that can be billed monthly or for short periods of time, like $5 for two weeks for travelers.
No ads please. Love it the sounds are fantastic only gave it 3 stars because a loud ad comes on in the middle of the night and wakes me up otherwise I would rate app 5 stars

Want to love it BUT ADs. This app is great except ads play randomly during the night and wake you up. The first two nights I didn’t notice any ads. The third night I was woke up by a voice talking 2-3 times.
Game shows start playing every hour. YOU ONLY GET ONE NIGHT OF SOUNDS. Then the next night a.weird game show starts playing EVERY HOUR. I’m SLEEPING. BYE!!!
Free app that’s actually free. So glad I don’t gotta pay for anything. Works even if my phone is off when I’m sleeping and it stays on until my alarms in the morning.
Plays ads and random noises during use. Will play selected sound for a while but then start playing ads and other noises randomly throughout. Terrible idea when using to keep a baby sleeping

Ads wake you up. This app is perfect except for the ads that wake you up in the middle of night hearing someone talking loudly. Like others have said I’d pay to remove the ads. With ads the app is useless!

Worked great 1 night then obnoxious ads started!. We got 1 peaceful night of sleep before the ads started waking me up. This is INSANE for a sleep app! There is no option to pay for ad-free or I would. The sounds are wonderful, but the ads have got to be removed or I will never be able to use this app again.
Ads. It keeps playing ads when you fall asleep. Terrible app. Finding another
Random songs play throughout the night. Used the app for 2 days without incident, now random songs play periodically through app…delete!

Terrible!. My wife and I used both used this app while on a vacation to mask noise in the hotel. After starting we we awoken often from a loud click that we THOUGHT was coming from the hotel mechanical room next door. We even complained to the front desk. After two nights of this we realized IT WAS THE APP WAKING US UP! ThThe clicks were coming from the app we both had running on our phones! We tried the app one more night after resetting it and several minutes after starting it the app suddenly starts playing a loud advertisement! Deleted it

Shame. This app worked great for a week. Then woke my baby up from a dead sleep with an ad. With no option to turn off ads or to purchase an upgrade to get rid of them, this app is completely useless.
DO NOT GET THIS APP. Others mention it, but it will randomly play ads. What a nightmare (literally). This is an awful app. I’m deleting it directly after writing this review.
Terrible app. Interrupting music and ads during the night will wake you up at all hours!

High-pitched sound every loop. High pitched squeak at the end of every brown noise loop. Pretty much the worst thing you can have in a sound loop. It only had one job, and it’s super fails. Cannot sleep with that high-pitched sound at the end of every brown noise loop. Amazingly bad, still can’t believe it

reviews.text: Not for babies. This app is crap. I use it for my baby and all the ads wake her up!

ABSOLUTELY AWEFUL. Not only does this app have an ad banner on the bottom of the screen, BUT IT ALSO PLAYS AUDIBLE ADDS INTERMITTENTLY THROUGH OUT THE NIGHT. I was sound asleep when an ad trashing white people came on. IT’S A SLEEP APP.
Pink Noise Skips. I’ve only listened to the pink noise on this app . The pink noise skips every so many minutes. It’s very annoying .
reviews.theme: артефакты и сбои в петле звука

reviews.text: Why ads?. Spoils the sleep due to ads

It has random Audio Ads. It’s ad sponsored. 

That isn’t the problem. 

The problem is that it has audio ads. They will play randomly, loudly, about once per hour. Some of them are Adult themed. 

Kind of ruins the idea of having a noise generator that helps you sleep. 

Imagine waking up at 2am with Donald Trump yelling at you. Or 3am with an adult actress encouraging you. 

That’s what this app gives you. If there could be zero stars and the option to report it to Apple, I would do it.
Wth?. Works great except in the middle of the night as your trying to sleep to the pink noise and suddenly there are ads talking to you and waking you up? Wth? Who thought that was a good idea?
Horrible. I put on the pink noise sound for twenty minutes and went to sleep and it almost made me deaf. Will not be using again
Ads wake you up. For an app that is supposed to help you sleep why would an ad start playing once you are asleep and wake you up? Terrible
Ocean Sounds. Very peaceful ocean sounds that work great. I just wish they were constant instead of stopping for a few seconds every few minutes. That would make my rate a 5.
reviews.theme: артефакты и сбои в петле звука

reviews.text: Creepy. I was loving this app for my newborn all the way up until it decided to play ads of creepy children whispering and screaming. Scared the hell out of me. I’ll go buy a sound machine.

Helps with tinnitus and hyperacusis. If you have tinnitus or hyperacusis, this app might be a life-changer for you. I know it was for me. The pink noise provides sound enrichment for my ears and helps “reset” them. The best method I’ve found to make it work is to put the iPhone’s actual speaker right next to my ear and slowly move it back and forth. If you have tinnitus or hyperacusis, it means your ears need to reset and are hungry for sound enrichment. Pink noise is the best way to enrich them!! Look up Chris Singleton on YouTube if you think you might have hyperacusis (sensitivity to every days noises). 

I just have one small criticism of this app. I would like to be able to pay to have the ads removed.
Random Voice. A male voice randomly started talking in the app about having children in the middle of my rainstorm. It woke up my sleeping baby. Not okay.

Ads. Fall asleep and an ad will play music periodically. If your using this to help you sleep that’s the last thing you want. 2am and awake writing this review bec this is the second time an add has played loudly waking me since 9pm. Terrible app.

Ads play loudly at random waking everyone up. I wanted to love this app however the obnoxious ads leading to malware ridden sites and the ads that disrupt the ambient sounds at random, made it impossible. I thought it was a one off but what went from one ad startling me and my baby awake quickly became 2 or 3 same night. The sound are imperfectly looped together and dips in the track could also be disturbing to the sleeper. Even if this app went paid, I would not spend the money for adfree given the experience. There is a competitive market for this type of app. Don't waste your time.
The sounds. The sounds are saasvghj
Sleep like a baby. Great selections of sounds. I use a combination of pink noise, forest, and ocean and sleep like a baby.

Love but!. Love love love this app I use it whenever I vacation and don’t have a physical fan or ac! Puts me right to sleep so quickly. Only issue I have is the rare random ads bc they’ll wake me up in the middle of the night where I’m like who the hell is watching smth next to me just to find out it’s my phone! I’d definitely pay to remove the ads if it was possible :/

Sleep interrupted.. The brown noise is my favorite. Unfortunately they put a loud ad an hour or so into it. Woke me from a sound sleep. They should play ad at beginning. Also can’t seem to find a time
Ads will wake you up. Downloaded this for my toddler and she was woken up by ads !! Beware!
Ads. Seriously? Ads in the middle of the night? How is that supposed to promote deep sleep. Garbage

Stop the ads!. I tried this out because I was looking for pink noise to help me sleep. All of a sudden a loud ad came on, woke me up, and scared me half to death! Then I couldn’t get back to sleep because of the adrenaline! Don’t bother!
Unusable. I downloaded this app to help me concentrate and sleep. The obnoxiously loud ads it plays break my concentration and wake me up. This is such a clear conflict of interest.

This was great until.... This app was wonderful for about a week, then one night musical ads begin to start up half an hour into the start of the pink sound app. A few days later the same thing happened again. What kind of sense does it make to pop up musical ads during a sleeping aid app? This app is useless. I would rather pay a reasonable fee up front and sleep peacefully!
Fix the add playing!!!!. Love this app but it randomly starts blasting the ads. I don’t mind having to watch an ad to launch it but having it interrupt your sleep like that, defeats the purpose.
Noisy adds. What are you thinking? Why would you accept noise making adds on an app for helping people sleep? Ruins app.
1st time. Sleeping better than I have in years!
Interruptions. After having the app on for a while some video or music starts playing and wakes me up

Good night sleep for 30 Mins then...... I would have rated this a 5 Star a month ago, but now every time I fall asleep with it on a crazy ad starts playing & wakes me up. When I click off the ad & go back to sleep with the lovely pink noise the ad starts up again about 30 mins to an hour later. I really LOVED this app before this & would use it every night for the pink noise, but now I have had to find another app to use, so I can actually sleep the entire night without being woken up by some crazy person talking or game ad playing & scaring me in the middle of the night!!

Horrible ad. It is awful to have to be sleeping and a horrible ad wakes you up with a cackling laugh and you have to X out before you can get the relaxing sounds again. Who needs that in the middle of the night!

Jarred awake by ad. I fell asleep with the pink noise going, only to wake up with a racing heart because of a loud voice and some gunfire. I had no idea ads would randomly pop up like that. Horrible experience, deleting app.
Ok but.... I want to use the app for sleep ... having an AUDIBLE commercial in the middle of the night is jarring and scary when it jerks you out of sleep.

Wakes you up with horrible loud commercials. Went to sleep with the soothing pink noise from app only to be woken up by jarring super loud horns and noise of one of their advertisers waking you up to play a game.

Time out feature. It would be nice if you can set a time duration and have the app turn off. I would use it to help fall asleep. I currently use the pink noise generator to help me set up intercom works nice.

Random ad. I enjoy the app especially because you can combine sounds but the last two nights some sort of ad wakes me up about 30 minutes or so after I try to sleep. I thought that the description says “uninterrupted”. I then have a very hard time falling back to sleep. It’s very disappointing.
I love it!. Great app! I can't sleep without it. My personal favorite is pink. The alarm system works very well for me having to get up early.

Amazing apps. This is the best White & Pink Noise app I have used. Its free and has a ton of different sounds to choose from. I have had no issues with this and would recommend to friends and co workers.

good app !. Really good. I use this every night. I have used it for over a year and haven't had a need to use any other app. It does what it's meant to do and it does it well. Definitely worth the download!
Uninstalling.. Not a lot of good as a sleep aid, when you get some advert blaring out to wake you up, uninstalling.

Do not use. I had just got my baby to sleep with the amazing pink noise when an advert started up which was 10x the volume of the pink noise. Baby woke up screaming and my whole day was messed up because of the lack of sleep. Waste of time app

Avoid... Noisy ads disrupt the pink noise. I understand free apps want to try and make money using ads... and noise generators are the perfect place for this. The problem with this app is that whole screen ads take over the app at regular intervals and either disrupt, or worse still have their awful audio come through the speakers making this app pointless. Avoid.
Beware in app ads!. Beware in app ads! No use for sleep if loud ads keep popping up!
Pink noise and funk is a bad combo. App is useless. When I put on pink noise I get app music. Totally ruins any application. Don’t bother.

Simple, good selection. I use this app for study in conjunction with sound cancelling headphones. I like mixing sounds such as brown noise + rain, or pink noise + space. Ads are only occasional, but a note to the developer: I would pay a small amount to get rid of them altogether. Shame it is not an option.

Keeps playing ads and waking baby. Not sure how to get rid of them but keeps playing ads and waking my baby!!!
It never used to do that!
Terrible. I could hear the sound of people talking in the background. Didn't put me to sleep, just creeped me out. Now I can't seem to delete it.
Woke up to someone speaking!. I wanted to use to sleep but suddenly I woke up to someone talking! Maybe an ad? Useless app to sleep with

Great noises but the ads are terrible. I really like the noise options, as simple as they are. But to be woken up by an ad for McDonalds? No way - immediately deleted it this morning and will never use it again unless there is an alternative version.

Great except for ads. I suffer badly from insomnia and was very hopefully this would work. By far the most relaxing sounds I’ve found on an app and it seemed to be helping. About a half hour in I was startled out of semi-sleep by an ad with voice over. I would pay for a premium app without ads but there does not seem to be an option.
Ads play randomly. Lately I’ve had weird ads pop up and play their jingle/music and wake my baby up. Not really useful for a pink noise app. Deal breaker.
Love it. True that it would be good to add more control (timer) but really, i dont mind. Love the fact i can mix and match the noise or play one by one.
Bien mais.... ... une commande globale (on /off) et un minuteur (sleep) serait apprécié.

Creepy talking when wifi on. If my wifi is on on my phone, I’ve heard Chinese people talking, also an African American sounding talk radio or something like that, and one time it was just loud nasty music. The pink noise is still playing but you can hear these voices. It’s really just creepy. 

ALSO it has little blips or millisecond pauses that can wake the baby up. The start and stop.

Woke up to weird music. I used this app to play pink noise at night for my baby and through the night was woken by strange music and a man singing. It creeped me out and I have deleted the app because it’s not nice to wake to.

Terrible loud adds. Have had this for a few months for my baby. Its just changed and has loud adds appear randomly during playback which renders it useless and wakes my baby up. don’t bother downloading unless you want the paid version.

Great app, spoiled by advertising. Very relaxing noises that send baby to sleep... and then a fullscreen advert comes on with loud audio, wakes everyone up, and the sounds do not resume after. I would probably pay a few bucks for this to be ad-free but there’s no option. Instead, just remember to turn on airplane mode so it can’t load adverts or it’ll ruin the experience.
